notes.title: Bye Sony Creative Software, hello MAGIX!
notes.notes:
With this update MAGIX is completing the transition phase following the official acquisition of the majority of Sony Creative Software products.

[b]Important note:[/b]

Customers who already have a version of the program from Sony Creative Software installed, won't get the update automatically.
The following post describes how you can install the update manually: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/278190/discussions/0/1843493219427398277/]Steam Forum[/url]

The previous version can always be restored after installing the update.
This is described in this post: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/278190/discussions/0/1843493219427398277/]Steam Forum[/url]

notes.title: December 1, 2015: Classic 8packs, Volume 3, FREE DOWNLOAD AVAILABLE NOW
notes.notes:
The Sony Sound Series Loops & Samples catalog is a vast repository of sonic memes. 8pack projects reveal magical combinations from the vault that hint at what’s possible for you, the artist/producer. Classic 8packs Volume 3 captures the ACID platform experience right when it was exploding on the scene for the first time. Now, we invite you to open these 50 inspired ACID projects once again, and rework them into contemporary masterpieces. Timeless and infinitely flexible, new creations made with these sounds will tap latent energies from a golden time marked by non-stop creative frenzy.

Classic 8packs, Volumes 1, 2, and 3 are free and available now. That’s 150 hits of pure inspiration. Download them all from inside the ACID Music Studio software interface and let the fun begin.

notes.title: October 2, 2015: Classic 8packs, Volume 2, FREE DOWNLOAD AVAILABLE NOW
notes.notes:
Great content and starter projects are what you need to make fire in ACID Music Studio 10. We have both, and we’re stacking the download zone with heaps of it. Free, royalty-free, and ready to roll, Classic 8packs Volume 2 now joins Volume 1 to form a classic double header. Download both, make room for Volume 3, and stay tuned.

Get ACID, get registered, get Classic 8packs V1 and V2, make some tracks, and get paid. We’re here for you.

notes.title: August 3, 2015: New FREE Content Available!
notes.notes:
Here it is, just like we promised: more content! Your first official free download has arrived, in the form of Classic 8packs, Volume 1. Use the 'Contests and Downloads' button in Music Studio to gain access to the entire package containing 50 ‘8pack’ projects and their associated loops – a juicy collection totaling nearly 400MB.

An 8pack is a Music Studio project that features at least 8 loops or samples from the Sound Series catalog. Our 8packs have enjoyed a long history of being fun, inspiring, and supremely useful. After you download and unpack Classic 8packs, Volume 1, use Music Studio to load and listen to any of the 50 included projects. Use any project as-is, or morph it into something completely new and different. Drag the individual loops and samples over to your master sound library for future use, and ALWAYS make sure to save a backup copy. The projects and all the associated sounds are yours to keep, royalty-free, hassle-free, and best of all – FREE! Download and enjoy, and thanks again for choosing Music Studio.
